title: Global venture capital firms pour 698 billion US Dollars in startups at the end of 3Q26 – CB Insights
source_used: BeBeez International (12 Oct 2026), summarising CB Insights' State of Venture Q3 2026; the CB Insights report itself was not found
key_facts: CB Insights' State of Venture Q3 2026, as summarised by BeBeez, says startups attracted $698.3 billion, above $484.1 billion in 2025 and $520.2 billion in 2022, which BeBeez calls the previous record year; the figures fit a total for 2026 to date.
The third quarter raised $187.2 billion, down from $219.6 billion in the second quarter but well above $122.4 billion in the third quarter of 2025.

There were 6,913 funding rounds in the third quarter, the lowest since 2022, down from 8,046 in the second quarter and 8,499 in the first; 299 rounds of at least $100 million took $149.2 billion, about 80 percent of the total.

AI companies raised $103.3 billion in the third quarter (55 percent), down from $153.1 billion in the second and a record $239.1 billion in the first, and $495.6 billion so far in 2026, 71 percent of the total.

OpenAI ($132 billion) and Anthropic ($95 billion) attracted about a third of all venture investment since January 2026; Anthropic tops private valuations at $1.2 trillion ahead of OpenAI at $852 billion.

Europe raised $31.5 billion in the third quarter, up 13 percent and its best quarter since the second quarter of 2022, led by Mistral's $3.5 billion round, though European deal counts fell 21 percent.
68 new unicorns (startups valued at $1 billion or more) were created, taking the global total to 1,471; 42 of them were AI companies.
M&A deals fell 9 percent to 2,353, the lowest since 2022, and there were 142 IPOs; large deals include SpaceX buying Anysphere at a $60 billion valuation and Stripe buying OpenRouter.
quote_evidence: CB Insights’ The State of Venture Q3 2026 says that in 3Q26 startups attracted 698.3 billion US Dollars, above 484.1 billion in 2025 and 520,2 billion of 2022, the previous record breaking year.
In 3Q26 deals amounted to 187.2 billion, down from 2Q26 219.6 billion, but well above the 3Q25 122.4.
In 2026, AI sector raised 495.6 billion, 71% of global venture capital deals value.
why_it_matters_hint: Venture money is at a record for the year but concentrated in fewer, larger deals, mostly AI, while the number of deals falls.
event_date: Quarter ending 30 Sep 2026; BeBeez published 12 Oct 2026 08:09 UTC; the date of the CB Insights release is not stated.
notes: Read BeBeez in full (the main session's fulltext copy lacks the opening paragraph, which was read on the live page). BeBeez's lead says startups raised 698.3 billion 'in 3Q26', but the quarter alone was 187.2 billion; the figures (AI 495.6 billion = 71 percent, OpenAI and Anthropic a third 'since January') fit a total for 2026 to date, which is how it is written. BeBeez calls 2022 the previous record year and has several typos ('2Q222', 'US Airtable'); only the main figures are used. The CB Insights report was not found, so all numbers are CB Insights' as relayed by BeBeez.
